name: @canonpack/content
description: Canonical pack payload: rule md files + Taskfile + tasks + git hooks. Assembled at pack time; empty in git.

scripts.prepack: node --input-type=module -e "import {cpSync,mkdirSync,readdirSync} from 'node:fs'; import {join} from 'node:path'; const root=join(import.meta.dirname??process.cwd(),'..','..'); const here=process.cwd(); for (const f of readdirSync(join(root,'content'))) cpSync(join(root,'content',f), join(here,f), {recursive:true}); cpSync(join(root,'Taskfile.yml'), join(here,'Taskfile.yml')); cpSync(join(root,'tasks'), join(here,'tasks'), {recursive:true}); cpSync(join(root,'.githooks'), join(here,'.githooks'), {recursive:true});"
scripts.postpack: node --input-type=module -e "import {readdirSync,rmSync} from 'node:fs'; for (const f of readdirSync(process.cwd())) { if (f !== 'package.json') rmSync(f, {recursive:true, force:true}); }"
